description: History of electricity generation and consumption data in Québec - Proxy is a dataset listed in Hydro-Québec open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Hydro-Québec. All of Hydro-Québec data on electricity generation and consumption in Québec. Updated annually, the audited data is sent to the Régie de l’énergie du Québec. The data covers every hour of every day in a one-year period and attests to the high volume of electricity that is transmitted on the province’s power lines. Coverage: Québec (Hydro-Québec). The portal files it under Electricity consumption. The portal shows 61,371 records. The portal shows 2025-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-donnees-hydroquebec-com-portal.
